question:
A company plans to produce three products, $A_{1}, A_{2}, A_{3}$, within a four-month timeframe (January to April). The demand for the products is shown in the table below:

| Demand | January | February | March | April |
| :---: | :---: | :---: | :---: | :---: |
| $A_{1}$ | 5300 | 1200 | 7400 | 5300 |
| $A_{2}$ | 4500 | 5400 | 6500 | 7200 |
| $A_{3}$ | 4400 | 6700 | 12500 | 13200 |

The prices, production costs, production quotas, activation costs, and minimum batch sizes (refer to the definitions in Exercise 4.3) are as follows:

| Product | $A_{1}$ | $A_{2}$ | $A_{3}$ |
| :---: | :---: | :---: | :---: |
| Unit Price | $\\$ 124$ | $\\$ 109$ | $\\$ 115$ |
| Activation Cost | $\\$ 150000$ | $\\$ 150000$ | $\\$ 100000$ |
| Production Cost | $\\$ 73.30$ | $\\$ 52.90$ | $\\$ 65.40$ |
| Production Quota | 500 | 450 | 550 |
| Minimum Batch Size | 20 | 20 | 16 |

January has 23 production days, February has 20, March has 23, and April has 22. The activation status of the production lines can be changed each month. The minimum batch size is calculated on a monthly basis.

In addition, storage space can be rented monthly at a cost of $\\$ 3.50$ for $A_{1}$, $\\$ 4.00$ for $A_{2}$, and $\\$ 3.00$ for $A_{3}$. Each product takes up the same amount of storage space. The total available capacity is 800 units.

Write a mathematical program to maximize revenue.

def build_model(data=None):
    d = data or DATA

    # Mutable month list captured in a plain tuple to avoid late-binding issues
    months = tuple(d["months"])

    model = pyo.ConcreteModel()

    model.P = pyo.Set(initialize=d["products"])
    model.T = pyo.Set(initialize=d["months"])

    # Decision variables
    model.x = pyo.Var(model.P, model.T, domain=pyo.NonNegativeIntegers)
    model.s = pyo.Var(model.P, model.T, domain=pyo.NonNegativeIntegers)
    model.y = pyo.Var(model.P, model.T, domain=pyo.Binary)

    def prev_month(t):
        idx = months.index(t)
        return months[idx - 1] if idx > 0 else None

    def next_month(t):
        idx = months.index(t)
        return months[idx + 1] if idx + 1 < len(months) else None

    # Objective: maximise revenue - variable costs.
    # Revenue term is price * demand (demand is fully met within horizon).
    def revenue_expr(m, p, t):
        return d["price"][p] * d["demand"][(p, t)]

    revenue_total = pyo.quicksum(
            d["price"][p] * d["demand"][(p, t)]
            for p in model.P for t in model.T
    )

    def prod_cost_expr(m, p, t):
        return d["prod_cost"][p] * m.x[p, t]

    prod_cost_total = pyo.quicksum(
            d["prod_cost"][p] * model.x[p, t]
            for p in model.P for t in model.T
    )

    act_cost_total = pyo.quicksum(
            d["activation_cost"][p] * model.y[p, t]
            for p in model.P for t in model.T
    )

    hold_cost_total = pyo.quicksum(
            d["hold_cost"][p] * model.s[p, t]
            for p in model.P for t in model.T
    )

    model.obj = pyo.Objective(
        expr=revenue_total - prod_cost_total - act_cost_total - hold_cost_total,
        sense=pyo.maximize,
    )

    # Production cannot exceed quota * available days if line activated;
    # and cannot exceed zero if line is not activated (big-M via quota*days)
    def quota_rule(m, p, t):
        days = d["days"][t]
        cap = d["quota"][p] * days
        return m.x[p, t] <= cap * m.y[p, t]
    model.quota_con = pyo.Constraint(model.P, model.T, rule=quota_rule)

    # Minimum batch size: if activated, production at least one min batch *
    # number of batches -> production >= batch_size * y  (a single batch minimum).
    def min_batch_rule(m, p, t):
        return m.x[p, t] >= d["batch"][p] * m.y[p, t]
    model.min_batch_con = pyo.Constraint(model.P, model.T, rule=min_batch_rule)

    # Inventory balance
    def balance_rule(m, p, t):
        pm = prev_month(t)
        prev_stock = m.s[p, pm] if pm is not None else 0
        return prev_stock + m.x[p, t] - m.s[p, t] == d["demand"][(p, t)]
    model.balance_con = pyo.Constraint(model.P, model.T, rule=balance_rule)

    # Storage capacity per month
    def storage_rule(m, t):
        return pyo.quicksum(m.s[p, t] for p in m.P) <= d["storage_capacity"]
    model.storage_con = pyo.Constraint(model.T, rule=storage_rule)

    return model

import pyomo.environ as pyo

# =============================================================================
# PROBLEM: Multi-product, multi-period production planning with activation
#          (setup) costs, minimum batch sizes, monthly storage and capacity.
#
# SETS / INDICES
#   P = {A1, A2, A3}          products, index p
#   T = {Jan, Feb, Mar, Apr}  months,   index t
#
# DECISION VARIABLES
#   x[p,t]  >= 0  integer   units of product p produced in month t
#   y[p,t]  binary          1 if product p's line is activated in month t
#   s[p,t]  >= 0  integer   units of product p held in storage at end of month t
#
# OBJECTIVE (maximize net revenue)
#   sum over p,t of  price[p] * x[p,t]
#     - sum over p,t of  prod_cost[p] * x[p,t]
#     - sum over p,t of  activation_cost[p] * y[p,t]
#     - sum over p,t of  storage_cost[p] * s[p,t]
#
# CONSTRAINTS
#   (1) Inventory balance:  s[p,t-1] + x[p,t] - s[p,t] = demand[p,t]
#   (2) Production quota:   x[p,t] <= quota[p] * days[t] * y[p,t]
#   (3) Minimum batch:      x[p,t] >= min_batch[p] * y[p,t]
#   (4) Storage capacity:   sum over p of s[p,t] <= storage_capacity
# =============================================================================

DATA = {
    "products": ["A1", "A2", "A3"],
    "months": ["Jan", "Feb", "Mar", "Apr"],
    "days": {"Jan": 23, "Feb": 20, "Mar": 23, "Apr": 22},
    "demand": {
        "A1": {"Jan": 5300, "Feb": 1200, "Mar": 7400, "Apr": 5300},
        "A2": {"Jan": 4500, "Feb": 5400, "Mar": 6500, "Apr": 7200},
        "A3": {"Jan": 4400, "Feb": 6700, "Mar": 12500, "Apr": 13200},
    },
    "price": {"A1": 124.0, "A2": 109.0, "A3": 115.0},
    "activation_cost": {"A1": 150000.0, "A2": 150000.0, "A3": 100000.0},
    "prod_cost": {"A1": 73.30, "A2": 52.90, "A3": 65.40},
    "quota": {"A1": 500, "A2": 450, "A3": 550},
    "min_batch": {"A1": 20, "A2": 20, "A3": 16},
    "storage_cost": {"A1": 3.50, "A2": 4.00, "A3": 3.00},
    "storage_capacity": 800,
}


def build_model(data=None):
    d = data or DATA

    model = pyo.ConcreteModel()

    model.P = pyo.Set(initialize=d["products"])
    model.T = pyo.Set(initialize=d["months"])

    # -------------------------------------------------------------------------
    # Variables
    # -------------------------------------------------------------------------
    model.x = pyo.Var(model.P, model.T, within=pyo.NonNegativeIntegers)
    model.y = pyo.Var(model.P, model.T, within=pyo.Binary)
    model.s = pyo.Var(model.P, model.T, within=pyo.NonNegativeIntegers)

    # -------------------------------------------------------------------------
    # Objective: maximize net revenue
    # -------------------------------------------------------------------------
    def obj_rule(m):
        revenue = sum(d["price"][p] * m.x[p, t] for p in m.P for t in m.T)
        prod = sum(d["prod_cost"][p] * m.x[p, t] for p in m.P for t in m.T)
        act = sum(d["activation_cost"][p] * m.y[p, t] for p in m.P for t in m.T)
        stor = sum(d["storage_cost"][p] * m.s[p, t] for p in m.P for t in m.T)
        return revenue - prod - act - stor

    model.obj = pyo.Objective(rule=obj_rule, sense=pyo.maximize)

    # -------------------------------------------------------------------------
    # (1) Inventory balance
    # -------------------------------------------------------------------------
    def balance_rule(m, p, t):
        idx = list(m.T).index(t)
        prev = m.s[p, list(m.T)[idx - 1]] if idx > 0 else 0
        return prev + m.x[p, t] - m.s[p, t] == d["demand"][p][t]

    model.balance = pyo.Constraint(model.P, model.T, rule=balance_rule)

    # -------------------------------------------------------------------------
    # (2) Production quota (big-M via quota * days)
    # -------------------------------------------------------------------------
    def quota_rule(m, p, t):
        return m.x[p, t] <= d["quota"][p] * d["days"][t] * m.y[p, t]

    model.quota = pyo.Constraint(model.P, model.T, rule=quota_rule)

    # -------------------------------------------------------------------------
    # (3) Minimum batch size
    # -------------------------------------------------------------------------
    def minbatch_rule(m, p, t):
        return m.x[p, t] >= d["min_batch"][p] * m.y[p, t]

    model.minbatch = pyo.Constraint(model.P, model.T, rule=minbatch_rule)

    # -------------------------------------------------------------------------
    # (4) Storage capacity
    # -------------------------------------------------------------------------
    def storage_rule(m, t):
        return sum(m.s[p, t] for p in m.P) <= d["storage_capacity"]

    model.storage = pyo.Constraint(model.T, rule=storage_rule)

    return model

    # sets
    "A": ["A1", "A2", "A3"],
    "months": ["Jan", "Feb", "Mar", "Apr"],
    # demand d[p][month] in units
    "demand": {
        "A1": [5300, 1200, 7400, 5300],

        "A3": [4400, 6700, 12500, 13200],

    "quota": {"A1": 500.0, "A2": 450.0, "A3": 550.0},
    "minbatch": {"A1": 20.0, "A2": 20.0, "A3": 16.0},
    "days": {"Jan": 23.0, "Feb": 20.0, "Mar": 23.0, "Apr": 22.0},
    "holdcost": {"A1": 3.50, "A2": 4.00, "A3": 3.00},
    "capacity": 800.0,
    "bigM": 1.0e7,
}


def build_model(data=None):
    d = data or DATA

    m = pyo.ConcreteModel()

    m.A = pyo.Set(initialize=d["A"], ordered=True)
    m.T = pyo.Set(initialize=d["months"], ordered=True)

    # ---- Variables ----
    # monthly production on product p, month t (integer unit batches)
    m.produce = pyo.Var(m.A, m.T, domain=pyo.NonNegativeIntegers, bounds=(0, None))
    # sales in each month
    m.sales = pyo.Var(m.A, m.T, domain=pyo.NonNegativeReals, bounds=(0, None))
    # end-of-month inventory
    m.invent = pyo.Var(m.A, m.T, domain=pyo.NonNegativeReals, bounds=(0, None))
    # activation of production line
    m.run = pyo.Var(m.A, m.T, domain=pyo.Binary)
    # storage rented in month t
    m.store = pyo.Var(m.T, domain=pyo.Binary)

    # ---- Objective: maximize revenue minus all costs ----
    def obj_rule(M):
        revenue = sum(d["price"][p] * M.sales[p, t] for p in M.A for t in M.T)
        act = sum(d["activate"][p] * M.run[p, t] for p in M.A for t in M.T)
        prod = sum(d["prodcost"][p] * M.produce[p, t] for p in M.A for t in M.T)
        hold = sum(d["holdcost"][p] * M.invent[p, t] for p in M.A for t in M.T)
        return revenue - act - prod - hold

    m.obj = pyo.Objective(rule=obj_rule, sense=pyo.maximize)

    # ---- Constraints ----

    def sales_cap_rule(M, p, t):
        idx = d["months"].index(t)
        return M.sales[p, t] <= d["demand"][p][idx]

    m.sales_cap = pyo.Constraint(m.A, m.T, rule=sales_cap_rule)

    # Balance: Jan has no opening stock
    def bal_rule(M, p, t):
        i = d["months"].index(t)
        if i == 0:
            return M.produce[p, t] == M.sales[p, t] + M.invent[p, t]
        val = M.invent[p, d["months"][i - 1]] + M.produce[p, t]
        return val == M.sales[p, t] + M.invent[p, t]

    m.balance = pyo.Constraint(m.A, m.T, rule=bal_rule)

    # production quota per month (capacity of the line)
    def quota_rule(M, p, t):
        cap = d["quota"][p] * d["days"][t]
        return M.produce[p, t] <= cap

    m.quota_cap = pyo.Constraint(m.A, m.T, rule=quota_rule)

    # big-M activation indicator
    def bigm_rule(M, p, t):
        return M.produce[p, t] <= d["bigM"] * M.run[p, t]

    m.prod_if_active = pyo.Constraint(m.A, m.T, rule=bigm_rule)

    # minimum batch size when the line is active
    def minbatch_rule(M, p, t):
        return M.produce[p, t] >= d["minbatch"][p] * M.run[p, t]

    m.minbatch = pyo.Constraint(m.A, m.T, rule=minbatch_rule)

    # storage capacity if rented
    def storage_rule(M, t):
        total = sum(M.invent[p, t] for p in M.A)
        return total <= d["capacity"] * M.store[t]

    m.storage_cap = pyo.Constraint(m.T, rule=storage_rule)

    return m

    )

    def balance_rule(m, p, t):

        return (
            sum(m.inventory[p, t] for p in m.P) <= d["storage_capacity"]
        )

    m.s = pyo.Var(m.P, m.T, within=pyo.NonNegativeReals)

    # Objective: maximize profit
    def obj_rule(m):
        revenue = sum(d["price"][p - 1] * d["demand"][p - 1][t - 1]
                      for p in m.P for t in m.T)
        prod_cost = sum(d["production_cost"][p - 1] * m.x[p, t]
                        for p in m.P for t in m.T)
        act_cost = sum(d["activation_cost"][p - 1] * m.b[p, t]
                       for p in m.P for t in m.T)
        stor_cost = sum(d["storage_cost"][p - 1] * m.s[p, t]
                        for p in m.P for t in m.T)
        return revenue - prod_cost - act_cost - stor_cost
    m.obj = pyo.Objective(rule=obj_rule, sense=pyo.maximize)

    # Production quota: x[p,t] <= days[t] * quota[p]
    def quota_rule(m, p, t):
        return m.x[p, t] <= d["days"][t - 1] * d["quota"][p - 1]
    m.quota_con = pyo.Constraint(m.P, m.T, rule=quota_rule)

    # Activation upper link: x[p,t] <= bigM * b[p,t]
    def act_upper_rule(m, p, t):
        return m.x[p, t] <= d["big_M"] * m.b[p, t]
    m.act_upper = pyo.Constraint(m.P, m.T, rule=act_upper_rule)

    # Activation lower link (min batch): x[p,t] >= min_batch[p] * b[p,t]
    def act_lower_rule(m, p, t):
        return m.x[p, t] >= d["min_batch"][p - 1] * m.b[p, t]
    m.act_lower = pyo.Constraint(m.P, m.T, rule=act_lower_rule)

    # Inventory balance: I[p,t] = I[p,t-1] + x[p,t] - demand[p,t]
    def inv_rule(m, p, t):
        prev = m.I[p, t - 1] if t > 1 else 0
        return m.I[p, t] == prev + m.x[p, t] - d["demand"][p - 1][t - 1]
    m.inv_balance = pyo.Constraint(m.P, m.T, rule=inv_rule)

    # Storage must cover inventory: s[p,t] >= I[p,t]
    def stor_link_rule(m, p, t):
        return m.s[p, t] >= m.I[p, t]
    m.stor_link = pyo.Constraint(m.P, m.T, rule=stor_link_rule)

    # Storage capacity: sum_p s[p,t] <= 800
    def stor_cap_rule(m, t):
        return sum(m.s[p, t] for p in m.P) <= d["storage_capacity"]
    m.stor_cap = pyo.Constraint(m.T, rule=stor_cap_rule)

    return m

    m = pyo.ConcreteModel()

    # Sets
    m.P = pyo.Set(initialize=d["products"])
    m.T = pyo.Set(initialize=d["months"])
    m.TI = pyo.Set(initialize=d["inventory_months"])

    # Variables
    # Production quantity (integer units)
    m.x = pyo.Var(m.P, m.T, domain=pyo.NonNegativeIntegers)

    # Activation binary
    m.y = pyo.Var(m.P, m.T, domain=pyo.Binary)

    # Ending inventory (integer units), only for inventory months
    m.I = pyo.Var(m.P, m.TI, domain=pyo.NonNegativeIntegers)

    # Storage rented (integer units), only for inventory months
    m.s = pyo.Var(m.P, m.TI, domain=pyo.NonNegativeIntegers)

    # Objective: maximize profit = revenue - production - activation - storage
    # Revenue uses demand met; since demand is fixed and must be satisfied,
    # profit = sum (price - prod_cost) * x - activation - storage
    def obj_rule(m):
        revenue_minus_prod = sum(
            (d["price"][p] - d["production_cost"][p]) * m.x[p, t]
            for p in m.P for t in m.T
        )
        activation = sum(
            d["activation_cost"][p] * m.y[p, t]
            for p in m.P for t in m.T
        )
        storage = sum(
            d["storage_cost"][p] * m.s[p, t]
            for p in m.P for t in m.TI
        )
        return revenue_minus_prod - activation - storage

    m.obj = pyo.Objective(rule=obj_rule, sense=pyo.maximize)

    # Inventory balance for each product and inventory month
    def balance_rule(m, p, t):
        idx = d["months"].index(t)
        if idx == 0:
            prev_inv = 0
        else:
            prev_t = d["months"][idx - 1]
            prev_inv = m.I[p, prev_t]
        return m.I[p, t] == prev_inv + m.x[p, t] - d["demand"][p][idx]

    m.balance = pyo.Constraint(m.P, m.TI, rule=balance_rule)

    # For April (last month) no inventory carried: production + inventory from March = demand
    def april_rule(m, p):
        last = d["months"][-1]
        idx = len(d["months"]) - 1
        prev_t = d["months"][idx - 1]
        return m.I[p, prev_t] + m.x[p, last] == d["demand"][p][idx]

    m.april_balance = pyo.Constraint(m.P, rule=april_rule)

    # Storage capacity per inventory month
    def storage_cap_rule(m, t):
        return sum(m.s[p, t] for p in m.P) <= d["storage_capacity"]

    m.storage_cap = pyo.Constraint(m.TI, rule=storage_cap_rule)

    # Storage linkage: rented storage must cover inventory
    def storage_link_rule(m, p, t):
        return m.s[p, t] >= m.I[p, t]

    m.storage_link = pyo.Constraint(m.P, m.TI, rule=storage_link_rule)

    # Production quota (capacity) linking with activation
    def quota_rule(m, p, t):
        cap = d["quota"][p] * d["days"][t]
        return m.x[p, t] <= cap * m.y[p, t]

    m.quota = pyo.Constraint(m.P, m.T, rule=quota_rule)

    # Minimum batch size when activated
    def minbatch_rule(m, p, t):
        return m.x[p, t] >= d["min_batch"][p] * m.y[p, t]

    m.minbatch = pyo.Constraint(m.P, m.T, rule=minbatch_rule)

    return m

    m.x = pyo.Var(m.PT, within=pyo.NonNegativeIntegers)

#

#   (1) Demand balance: s[p,t-1] + x[p,t] = demand[p,t] + s[p,t]
#   (2) Production quota: x[p,t] <= quota_p * days_t * y[p,t]
#   (3) Minimum batch:   x[p,t] >= min_batch_p * y[p,t]
#   (4) Storage capacity: sum_p s[p,t] <= 800
#   (5) Initial storage s[p,0] = 0

}

    products = d["products"]
    months = d["months"]

    model = pyo.ConcreteModel()

    model.P = pyo.Set(initialize=products)
    model.T = pyo.Set(initialize=months)

    # x[p,t]: production quantity
    model.x = pyo.Var(model.P, model.T, within=pyo.NonNegativeIntegers)

    # s[p,t]: end-of-month storage
    model.s = pyo.Var(model.P, model.T, within=pyo.NonNegativeIntegers)

    # y[p,t]: activation binary
    model.y = pyo.Var(model.P, model.T, within=pyo.Binary)

    # Objective: maximize net revenue
    def obj_rule(m):
        revenue = sum(
            (d["price"][p] - d["production_cost"][p]) * m.x[p, t]
            for p in m.P for t in m.T
        )
        activation = sum(

        )

    def storage_cap_rule(m, t):

def build_model(data=None):
    d = data or DATA

    model = pyo.ConcreteModel()

    model.P = pyo.Set(initialize=d["products"])
    model.T = pyo.Set(initialize=d["months"])

    # x[p,t]: units produced
    model.x = pyo.Var(model.P, model.T, within=pyo.NonNegativeIntegers)

    # s[p,t]: units stored at end of month t
    model.s = pyo.Var(model.P, model.T, within=pyo.NonNegativeIntegers)

    # y[p,t]: activation binary
    model.y = pyo.Var(model.P, model.T, within=pyo.Binary)

    # precompute max production per month as a parameter
    def maxprod_init(m, p, t):
        return d["quota"][p] * d["days"][t]

    model.maxprod = pyo.Param(model.P, model.T, initialize=maxprod_init)

    # ---- objective ----
    # revenue - production cost - activation cost - storage cost
    def revenue(m):
        return sum(d["price"][p] * d["demand"][p][t] for p in m.P for t in m.T)

    def prod_cost_expr(m):
        return sum(d["prod_cost"][p] * m.x[p, t] for p in m.P for t in m.T)

    def act_cost_expr(m):
        return sum(d["activation_cost"][p] * m.y[p, t] for p in m.P for t in m.T)

    def stor_cost_expr(m):
        return sum(d["storage_cost"][p] * m.s[p, t] for p in m.P for t in m.T)

    # Revenue is fixed by demand (all demand must be met), so it is a constant;
    # maximizing revenue == maximizing profit here. We model profit maximization
    # which is equivalent given fixed satisfied demand.
    model.obj = pyo.Objective(
        expr=revenue(model) - prod_cost_expr(model)
        - act_cost_expr(model) - stor_cost_expr(model),
        sense=pyo.maximize,
    )

    # ---- demand balance ----
    # production_t + stock_{t-1} - stock_t = demand_t   (stock_0 = 0)
    def balance_rule(m, p, t):
        prev = m.s[p, t - 1] if t > 1 else 0
        return m.x[p, t] + prev - m.s[p, t] == d["demand"][p][t]

    model.balance = pyo.Constraint(model.P, model.T, rule=balance_rule)

    # ---- max production: x <= maxprod * y ----
    def max_rule(m, p, t):
        return m.x[p, t] <= m.maxprod[p, t] * m.y[p, t]

    model.max_prod = pyo.Constraint(model.P, model.T, rule=max_rule)

    # ---- minimum batch: x >= min_batch * y ----
    def min_rule(m, p, t):
        return m.x[p, t] >= d["min_batch"][p] * m.y[p, t]

    model.min_prod = pyo.Constraint(model.P, model.T, rule=min_rule)

    # ---- storage capacity: total stock each month <= capacity ----
    def cap_rule(m, t):
        return sum(m.s[p, t] for p in m.P) <= d["storage_capacity"]

    model.storage_cap = pyo.Constraint(model.T, rule=cap_rule)

    return model
